caption:
Being cited by AI is the new page 1 of Google.

More people now ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google's AI answers "who's a good painter near me" and get a short list of names, without ever clicking a website.

If you're not on that list, you don't lose the click. You lose the chance to be considered.

The AI pulls from what it can read and trust about you:
→ Reviews that mention the service and the city
→ A Google Business Profile that's complete and active
→ Your name showing up in local lists, directories and articles
→ A website that says clearly what you do, where, and for whom

This has a name: GEO, generative engine optimization. Most small businesses haven't heard of it yet. That's the opportunity.

Comment "GEO" if you want to know if AI recommends your business.
